Compaction Rolls.name: Steel Ingots
Compaction Rolls.reasoning: Compaction rolls require very strong and durable metal, steel ingots are the base material for manufacturing heavy-duty steel parts essential for compaction rolls. Steel is industry standard due to its mechanical strength and wear resistance.

Compaction Rolls.name: Chromium
Compaction Rolls.reasoning: Chromium is often used for surface hardening (chromium plating) of compaction rolls for wear resistance, enhancing roll durability. Common in industry for hard coatings.

Compaction Rolls.name: Titanium
Compaction Rolls.reasoning: Titanium or titanium compounds can be used in high-performance rolls for corrosion resistance and strength but are less common and alternative steels exist.

Compaction Rolls.name: Aluminum
Compaction Rolls.reasoning: Aluminum sometimes used in lightweight parts or roll shells but less common due to strength; lower confidence as steel dominates.

Drive System (motors And Gearbox).name: Steel Ingots
Drive System (motors And Gearbox).reasoning: Steel is the primary raw material for motor shafts, gears, and gearbox structure, essential for mechanical strength and precision.

Drive System (motors And Gearbox).name: Copper
Drive System (motors And Gearbox).reasoning: Copper is the critical raw material for motor windings and electrical conductors in the drive system, universally used due to excellent conductivity.

Drive System (motors And Gearbox).name: Aluminum
Drive System (motors And Gearbox).reasoning: Aluminum is commonly used for motor housings and cooling fins due to light weight and good thermal conductivity but alternatives like steel exist.

Drive System (motors And Gearbox).name: Iron
Drive System (motors And Gearbox).reasoning: Iron is used in magnetic cores of motors and gearboxes; often in form of electrical steel laminations. Important but could have some substitutes.

Feeder System.name: Steel Ingots
Feeder System.reasoning: Steel is broadly used for structural elements and mechanical parts in feeder systems due to strength and wear resistance.

Feeder System.name: Aluminum
Feeder System.reasoning: Aluminum may be used for lightweight structural parts in feeders but not as universal as steel.

Roller Gap Adjustment Mechanism.name: Steel Ingots
Roller Gap Adjustment Mechanism.reasoning: Steel is the main material for the precision mechanical parts like screws, levers, and frame of the adjustment mechanism due to strength and machinability.

Roller Gap Adjustment Mechanism.name: Aluminum
Roller Gap Adjustment Mechanism.reasoning: Aluminum may be used in some components for weight reduction but less common than steel.

Roller Gap Adjustment Mechanism.name: Copper
Roller Gap Adjustment Mechanism.reasoning: Copper could be used in electrical components or wiring related to actuators but not structurally critical, so lower confidence.

Control Panel.name: Copper
Control Panel.reasoning: Copper is universally used for electrical wiring, circuit boards, and connectors in control panels due to excellent electrical conductivity.

Control Panel.name: Aluminum
Control Panel.reasoning: Aluminum may be used for structural parts or heat sinks in control panels but less critical.

Control Panel.name: Silicon
Control Panel.reasoning: Silicon is the fundamental semiconductor material in electronic components of control panels.

Machine Frame/base.name: Steel Ingots
Machine Frame/base.reasoning: Structural frame and base typically require heavy-duty steel for mechanical strength and rigidity, standard industry practice.

Machine Frame/base.name: Aluminum
Machine Frame/base.reasoning: Aluminum may be used for lighter frames or components but steel dominates due to strength requirements.
